maddeler.e:
نتعاوض (form VI)
# نَتَعَاوَضُ (nataʕāwaḍu) /na.ta.ʕaː.wa.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاوَضَ (taʕāwaḍa)
# نَتَعَاوَضَ (nataʕāwaḍa) /na.ta.ʕaː.wa.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاوَضَ (taʕāwaḍa)
# نَتَعَاوَضْ (nataʕāwaḍ) /na.ta.ʕaː.wadˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاوَضَ (taʕāwaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
